content:
Ava: Quick heads-up — I'm triaging a batch of docs PRs that accidentally reintroduced old microcopy tokens (`style:` / `voice:`) into examples. We should have a safelist + blocking CI so this doesn't slip through again.

Ravi: Agreed. I can own a safelist YAML and a tiny library to validate snippets. Thinking path: `/docs/style/safelist.yml`. It will map legacy -> canonical and list allowed tone tokens.

Olga: Love that. Let's keep the allowed token set small. Suggest `helpful`, `concise`, `neutral`. Add `strict` only for legal messages.

Ravi: Proposed safelist format (rough):
```yaml
allowed_tokens:
  - helpful
  - concise
  - neutral
  - strict
mapping:
  voice: tone
  style: tone
  friendly: helpful
  empathetic: helpful
```
I'll also provide a script `scripts/check-snippets` that fails if a snippet uses a non-allowed token.

Ava: Two ask items: (1) docs CI should fail PRs that modify examples with disallowed tokens, (2) PRs that change the token mapping must include a migration note in the PR template.

CLI-bot: cli-bot ran snippet scan on branch `fix/snippets` — found 9 occurrences of `voice: friendly` in `examples/*`.

Ravi: I'll open PR with safelist + CI job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 (WIP). It wires `docs-snippet-check` into the GH Actions matrix and adds a `snippets-ignore.txt` for known intentional exceptions.

Olga: Minor language suggestion: call the file `safelist.yml` rather than `golden-phrases` to make intent clear (prevent reintroduction rather than declare definitive phrasing). Also add a small README linking to product tone decisions.

Ava: Who will own the product tone sign-off? I can loop in Priya from Product. We need final approval before Ravi flips any snippet values.

Ravi: For the SDK side, I'll change examples to use `tone: helpful` for conversational demos and `tone: concise` for code/CLI examples. Example patch:```js
// old
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', voice: 'friendly', prompt: 'How do I connect a db?' })
// new
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', tone: 'helpful', prompt: 'How do I connect a database?' })
```I'll include a unit that loads examples and asserts tokens are in the safelist.

Ava: Timeline proposal:
- Ravi: PR for safelist + CI by Tue EOD
- Priya/Product: tone sign-off by Thu
- Ravi: snippet updates + tests by next Mon
- Docs team: merge window next Tue

Priya: (via thread) I reviewed the suggested tokens. Approve `helpful`, `concise`, `neutral`. `strict` needs legal sign-off for warnings.

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR label `docs/snippet-change` added to https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501

Olga: One more: add a changelog entry under `/docs/CHANGELOG.md` with a short migration note and examples of before/after so integrators know what field names changed.

Ravi: Acknowledged. I'll include changelog and a small migration guide snippet to paste into release notes.

Ava: Thanks all. If anyone spots stray `voice:` tokens after merge, ping me in #docs and I'll roll a targeted follow-up. :mag:

CLI-bot: cli-bot: scheduled snippet scan nightly and will report new finds to #docs.
